description:
VERIFICATION TASK (may require small fixes, not a full implementation).

The macro generates init/1 at compile time. Loader.load_from_factory/2 (loader.ex:91) compiles extensions at runtime via Code.compile_file or accepts a factory fn. The two loading paths need to be verified as compatible.

SCENARIO TO VERIFY:
1. A module using 'use OctoPi.Coder.Extension' compiled as part of the app (not dynamic) -- should work trivially since init/1 is generated at compile time.
2. A module using 'use OctoPi.Coder.Extension' loaded dynamically via Loader.load/1 (Code.compile_file) -- the macro runs during compile_file, so init/1 is generated. Verify this works end-to-end.
3. Test pattern: Loader.load_from_factory('name', &MacroExtension.init/1) -- should work since the macro generates a standard init/1.

If any incompatibility is found, fix it in Loader or the macro. Document the finding in this ticket.

ALSO: Confirm that load_from_factory with a factory fn that does NOT use the macro (old pattern) still works. No regression.

This ticket is a gate: Phase 5 migration tickets must not start until this verification passes.
title: Verify load_from_factory compatibility with macro-based extensions
